title: Writing Effective Appointment Reminders for Dog Groomers | Pawfectly Booked

facts.fact: The guide recommends sending appointment reminders 24 to 48 hours before the appointment.
facts.quote: The sweet spot is **24 to 48 hours before** the appointment.

facts.fact: The guide states that many salons use two reminder touches: an email 48 hours before and an SMS 24 hours before the appointment.
facts.quote: Many salons use two touches: an email 48 hours out and an SMS 24 hours out.

facts.fact: Pawfectly Booked says its automated reminder timing can be set anywhere from 1 to 72 hours before an appointment.
Pawfectly Booked states that it personalises and sends every reminder automatically on the Gold plan, and that email booking confirmations are included on every plan.
facts.quote: Pawfectly Booked personalises and sends every reminder automatically on the Gold plan (email booking confirmations are included on every plan).

facts.fact: Pawfectly Booked offers a free trial of 14 days.
The Pawfectly Booked free trial requires no credit card, according to its related-resources link text.
Active Standard and Gold Pawfectly Booked subscriptions include a separate marketing feature called Reminder to Book In.
facts.quote: Active Standard and Gold subscriptions also include a separate marketing feature called Reminder to Book In

facts.fact: Pawfectly Booked states that appointment reminders do not use Marketing Credits, whereas the Reminder to Book In feature does.
facts.quote: Appointment reminders do not use Marketing Credits; Reminder to Book In does.
